title: A tiger’s fare, a snake’s fare
odia:
ଥିଲେ ବାଘର ଆହାର
ନଥିଲେ ସାପର ଆହାର।
literal_meaning: When there is [food], a tiger’s fare; when there is none, a snake’s fare.
meaning_odia: ଖାଦ୍ୟ ଥିବା ଓ ନଥିବାର ଦୁଇ ଅବସ୍ଥାକୁ ଏହି ତୁଳନାରେ ପଢ଼ାଯାଇଛି। ସମଧ୍ୱନିର ଏକ ସମ୍ପର୍କିତ ପାଠରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଅଂଶ ପବନ ଆହାର; ଲେଖିକା ତାହାକୁ ଅମଳ ପରର ପ୍ରଚୁର ଖାଇବା ଓ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଅଭାବ ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗରେ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିଛନ୍ତି। ଏଠାରେ ମୂଳ ସାପର ଆହାର ରଖାଯାଇଛି; ସାପର ଏହି ଚିତ୍ରର ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ତାତ୍ପର୍ଯ୍ୟ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ହୋଇନାହିଁ।
explanation: We read this as a contrast between plentiful eating and shortage, guided by a related expression in Dr Namita Sarangi’s Samadhwani article on winter and harvest. That version ends with air as food. The upload instead says “a snake’s fare,” which remains unchanged here; its precise figurative force is uncertain. The bracketed food makes the contextual completion visible.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A household uses its food stores freely when they are full and later has very little left. Someone recalls the contrast between fare in plenty and fare in scarcity.
cultural_context: The inspected article uses its tiger-and-air version while discussing food consumed after harvest and a later shortage. That is an attested context for the related saying, not evidence of the uploaded snake image’s origin or an assertion about animal feeding.

witnesses.locator: Page23, sixth item beginning ଥିଲେ ବାଘର ଆହାର.
witnesses.note: Exact uploaded wording and line break retained. Food availability is a contextual reading; the precise nuance of ସାପର ଆହାର remains uncertain.

witnesses.locator: Paragraph discussing Pusha harvest, consumption and saving; line185 in inspected digital text.
witnesses.note: Related expression: ଥିଲେ ବାଘର ଆହାର ନଥିଲେ ପବନ ଆହାର । Public ପବନ differs from upload ସାପର. Article supplies abundance/shortage context, not exact uploaded second-clause attestation.

origin_note: Upload supplies the tiger/snake wording. Samadhwani supplies a related tiger/air expression in a stated food-availability context. Earliest origin and shared lineage unknown.

odia_summary: ଖାଦ୍ୟର ପ୍ରଚୁରତା ଓ ଅଭାବର ଏକ ତୁଳନା; ସାପର ଚିତ୍ରର ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ତାତ୍ପର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଅନିଶ୍ଚିତ।
english_summary: A contrast of plenty and shortage, with the snake image’s precise nuance unresolved.
